title: Sample: the mascot handles it
note: An empty guiding sample. Each line's `note` says what that slot is for; replace the text and keep the structure. Any language works: the voice provider decides the accent.

lines.text: [warm, a little tired] Here is the *problem*, in one short line.
lines.note: Hook: the everyday problem in one sentence, in the viewer's words. The first frame already shows it.
The problem talks: a message, a customer or an object waiting, voiced as a character.

lines.text: Then your *helper* drops in and handles it.
lines.note: Turn: the mascot arrives. Say what it does, not what it is.

lines.text: Every grey thing it touches turns *your* colour.
lines.note: Payoff: one beat per thing it handles; each one turns the accent colour.

lines.text: [warm] Close on one *promise*. Then say your name.
lines.note: Close: one promise, then the end card says the name. No price or number you cannot prove.
